hotel_name: Homestay Near Isbt Kashmiri Gate & Metro | Private Rooms & Dorms

positive_snippets:
I recently stayed at this AC dormitory near ISBT Kashmere Gate, and honestly, it was exactly what I needed.
Location-wise, it’s a big win. Being so close to the ISBT and Kashmere Gate Metro station makes travel super easy, especially if you’re arriving late or catching an early bus. You can literally walk with your luggage without stressing.
The dormitory itself was clean and properly maintained. The AC worked well (which really matters in Delhi), and the bedding was fresh and comfortable. Washrooms were cleaned regularly, and there was no unpleasant smell — something that’s rare in budget dorm setups.
What stood out most was the staff. They were polite, cooperative, and didn’t behave like you were “just another booking.” Check-in was smooth, and they were helpful with basic local guidance.
If you’re a solo traveler, student, or someone just passing through Delhi and need a safe, affordable place near ISBT Kashmere Gate, this AC dormitory is a solid choice. You get value for money without compromising on basic comfort.
Would definitely stay again.

Less than a 5 minute walk from Kasmiri gate bus stand. Whole property was very clean. Dorms clean. Big washroom/showers clean. There's a communal space. The staff are so lovely and kind here. Felt very safe. Good price. They also let me keep my bags after check out. Dorm was quiet. Highly recommend. We're actually going back to stay again tomorrow. :)

Very satisfied with the stay. The staff are professional and friendly, and they provide support almost 24 hours a day, which is really impressive.
Their English is also good compared to the average. If you need anything, just ask - they’re very helpful.
